# Love, Ipon — Build Progress

**This is the cold-start orientation file** (see `CLAUDE.md`'s "How to Start Each Conversation"). Read this file first, then the version doc for whatever's in flight, then one reference feature folder and the relevant `supabase/schema.sql` table before writing code.

**Update this file's "Current state" section (and the relevant `vX.Y.md` file) after every commit.** This is the single source of truth for orientation in the next conversation — keep it current, not the git log.

**Keep "Current state" short — a pointer, not a changelog.** Per-slice detail (files touched, on-device verification, bugs found) belongs in the version's own `vX.Y.md` doc, not here. Once a version is released, its narrative detail is duplicated by the Version table below and by that doc — trim it out of this section rather than leaving it to accumulate.

---

## Current state (as of 2026-08-03, latest)

**Two batches are live, deliberately split 2026-08-03.** **[v1.7.3.md](v1.7.3.md) is now a receipt-OCR-only release batch** — Item 2 (receipt scan, design-locked [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-receipt-scan-ocr-prefilled-draft.md)) is its only non-deferred item, and it is transitively blocked on Item 5's de-risking spike, which is itself waiting on **10-15 real PH receipt photos from Alvin**. Items 3 (voice) and 4 (subcategories) stay shelved. Nothing here is actionable until that corpus arrives. **[v1.7.4.md](v1.7.4.md) is the new web-app track** and holds the W-series build work, opening with **Item 1 (freeze the cross-platform contract, W2) — ✅ GRILLED 2026-08-03, not yet built** (moved from v1.7.3 Item 1). **Two outcomes from that grill matter beyond the item.** (1) **`DeterministicUuid` is NOT `commonMain`-ready** — it is Android-free but JVM-bound (`java.nio.ByteBuffer`, `java.security.MessageDigest`, `java.util.UUID`), contradicting W8's claim that it already is. The KMP extraction therefore **rewrites** it onto different SHA-1 and UUID primitives rather than moving it, and a byte-order slip there silently produces different ids (duplicate rows, no error). The conformance vectors are the only mechanism that catches this, so they are the item's load-bearing deliverable and must exist before W10 phase 2; W10 phase 1 (empty module + Kotlin/JS target) can run in parallel. Treat "zero Android imports" as necessary but **not sufficient** evidence of portability. (2) **Web v1 is online-only** ([ADR-0063](../adr/0063-web-v1-is-online-only.md)) — this closes W8's offline-first-vs-online-first tension and settles contract §9: grouped multi-debt settlement stays Android-only, no `SECURITY DEFINER` RPC now, with the forward rule frozen that any future all-or-nothing-across-tables feature is designed server-side from the start if web must author it. Android must not migrate onto such an RPC either (it would lose offline settle). **Working checkout consolidated 2026-08-03** — ipon-love is now worked on directly in `kun-agent-workspace/projects/ipon-love`; the standalone `/Users/lovzay/ipon-love` clone is retired. `local.properties` was carried across, but note a fresh clone still cannot even *configure* Gradle without it (see v1.7.3 Item 6's closing note). Room stays **v31**; Supabase current through migration #23. Below this line: the prior v1.7.2/v1.7.1 narrative, now historical.

**v1.7.2 in flight** ([v1.7.2.md](v1.7.2.md)), successor to closed v1.7.1. **Item 1 (lock the entitlement columns, [ADR-0060](../adr/0060-entitlement-columns-are-rpc-write-only.md)) `DONE 8854547` (Opus/high)** — built, migration applied to staging, tests green (1275), on-device verified (dispatched, 5/5, no bugs). The native execution of [web-phase-0-prep.md W1](../web/web-phase-0-prep.md#w1--lock-the-entitlement-columns-rls--validating-write-rpc): the four entitlement columns lose direct write access and become reachable only through a `set_self_entitlement` RPC. **Two findings worth carrying forward.** (1) The booked `REVOKE UPDATE (cols)` is a **silent no-op** against Supabase's table-level grant — the working form drops the table grant and *allowlists* the 9 profile columns back, so **adding a `users` column now needs a matching `grant` or that field silently stops syncing**. (2) Offline-first was preserved by putting the RPC call inside `UserTableSyncer.remotePush()` alongside the upsert, reusing the existing dirty-row outbox, rather than routing `writeSelfEntitlement()` to the RPC directly as booked — which would have made entitlement the one write in the app that is *lost* offline. **Receipt validation deliberately deferred** — the RPC is a passthrough, so a forged call still works; this closes the door without locking it, and verification must precede enforcement flip-day / W7 / AI, whichever is first. ADR-0044 amended. Room stays **v31**. Below this line: the prior v1.7.1 narrative, now historical.

**v1.7.1's original fifteen items** — all DONE, per below. **Item 14 (Calculator as an in-app floating overlay bubble) `DONE 8903921` 2026-07-28 (Opus/medium) — built + on-device verified (dispatched: 10/10 golden-path scenarios clean, plus a focused re-verification of a found-and-fixed bug, no bugs remaining)**, per [ADR-0058](../adr/0058-calculator-overlay-module.md): `NavDestination` gains a `navigable` flag, `false` for Calculator alone (the registry's first module with no graph) — tapping it now spawns a draggable, edge-snapped, value-carrying pill over the current screen instead of navigating; `CalculatorScreen.kt` and its nav graph are deleted, state is hoisted into `IponAppContent` as `rememberSaveable`. **The ADR caught one crash trap (the nav-restore guard) but missed a second, worse one:** `NavResolver.startRoute` also turns a module id into the NavHost's *start destination*, and Calculator is pinnable — anyone with it as their first pin would have crashed on *every* launch, not just a one-time migration; fixed alongside the ADR's guard, both with regression tests. **On-device found one real bug, in this slice's own new code, not the ADR's design:** the collapsed pill's visibility depended on a `LaunchedEffect` key set that could go stale forever whenever the pill was parked on the left edge at the top of its travel range (both `restX` and `restY` constant in that corner, so no key ever changed after the first unmeasured pass) — surfaced by an Activity recreation, misdiagnosed on first pass as an app-lock interaction; fixed by adding the measured pill size to the key list, then re-verified clean across three corners, a forced recreation, and collapse/expand cycling. `FeatureLockedPanel` (the S9 whole-module paywall wall) is now unused — kept, not deleted, as the still-designed primitive for the next whole-module gate. No schema/Room/Supabase change. Prior: **Item 15 (editing a debt-settlement row strips `is_settlement`) `DONE d0ab8d5` 2026-07-28 (Sonnet/low) — built + on-device verified (dispatched: golden path, amount-edit re-save, normal-row + adjustment-row regressions, no bugs found)**, threading `isSettlement` through `TransactionEditorState`/`TransactionEditorReducer.build()` and hiding the category picker for settlement rows, mirroring Item 13's `isAdjustment` groove. No schema/Room change. **Item 11 (occasional in-app nudge to try the home-screen widgets) `DONE 0c9e36d` 2026-07-28 (Sonnet/low) — built + on-device verified**, a pattern-follow of Analysis' `PairingNudgeCard` dismissible-card mechanism; a local latch was needed so the card's own composition-stamps-shown design doesn't self-hide before the user reads it (see the version doc's Build outcome). **Item 8 (promote Recurring to its own top-level module) `DONE 4f499b3` 2026-07-28 (Sonnet/medium) — built + on-device verified**, a pure nav-graph restructuring following Notes' precedent. **Item 7 (move Export from Records' overflow menu to Settings) `DONE 56d41d6` 2026-07-28 (Sonnet/low) — built + on-device verified**, a pure navigation relocation into the Finance section. **Item 5 (Manage-module kebab icons black in dark mode) `DONE ec72e41` 2026-07-28 (Sonnet/low) — built + on-device verified**, a mechanical `tint` fix across Accounts/Budgets/Categories/Goal-detail. **Item 6 (notification inbox / bell) `DONE ccf933b` 2026-07-27 (Opus/high) — built + on-device verified**, the batch's foundation slice: a synced own-user-only inbox ([ADR-0053](../adr/0053-notification-inbox-synced-source-of-truth.md), Way A inbox-primary, **Room v30**, migration #22, `NOTIFICATIONS` last in the ADR-0009 order), with budget alerts migrated in as the pilot producer — which retired `BudgetAlertStore`/`BudgetAlertModule`/`BudgetAlertNotifier` and generalised the last into `SystemNotificationPresenter`. **ADR-0056 corrections, 2026-07-28 (review pass, Alvin):** three points folded into [ADR-0056](../adr/0056-off-app-recurring-reminder-periodic-sweep.md) + the version doc after the grill closed. (1) A `SettingsSectionHeader("Recurring")` ships with the item — the "Recurring reminders" row currently sits header-less between the Budgets and Couple sections, so it reads as a Budgets control, and nesting the new sub-row under it compounds that. (2) **App Standby buckets throttle this hardest for exactly the non-opening user it targets** (`rare`/`restricted` defer periodic jobs to ~daily), so 6h is a ceiling, not a promise — a further argument for 6h over 24h, and for adding no constraints; the hedged copy is load-bearing, not politeness. (3) Decision 8's account-switch rationale was **wrong and is corrected**: `LocalDataWiper` never clears `@FinanceDataStore`, so this toggle — like every shipped notification pref — is **device-global, not per-account**, and the next login re-arms from the inherited `true`. The sign-out cancel still earns its place (it stops a signed-out phone waking forever); only its stated reason changed. Left device-global deliberately, for consistency with Items 2-4/9; per-account scoping would be its own item. Also corrected: each periodic wake is a full `IponApp.onCreate()` when the process is cold, not merely the Room read.

Fills + freezes the still-`⬜` sections of [cross-platform-contract.md](../web/cross-platform-contract.md) plus a conformance-vector test suite so an Android drift fails the build instead of diverging silently. **Grill outcome:** (1) proceed now rather than wait on W10 — the wait was circular, and the web track could start within 48h; (2) **the conformance vectors are the load-bearing deliverable, not the prose**, because `DeterministicUuid` is *not* `commonMain`-ready (it is Android-free but JVM-bound on `ByteBuffer`/`MessageDigest`/`java.util.UUID`), so the KMP extraction **rewrites** it onto different SHA-1 and UUID primitives — a byte-order slip there silently yields different ids, i.e. duplicate rows, and the vectors are the only thing that catches it; they must exist before W10 phase 2, while W10 phase 1 can run in parallel; (3) **§9 decided → FROZEN**: grouped multi-row settlement stays Android-only, no `SECURITY DEFINER` RPC now, because the upstream question resolved to **web v1 is online-only** ([ADR-0063](../adr/0063-web-v1-is-online-only.md)) — the binding output is the forward rule that any future all-or-nothing-across-tables feature is designed server-side from the start if web must author it; (4) definition of done amended — §7's allowed web origin stays deliberately unfrozen pending the Vercel-vs-Cloudflare hosting choice. **W8's offline-first-vs-online-first tension is closed by ADR-0063**; W8 and W10 corrected for the `DeterministicUuid` claim, with the extraction estimate flagged for rebooking. To start/continue in a fresh convo: `/orient`, then *"continue the paywall build — next unchecked slice in subscription-paywall-design.md §12."* One-concern-per-commit still holds (the paywall is ~a dozen slices, never one commit; wire-only gates grouped by mechanism). **AI (#3) monetization — resolved (2026-07-07, D8):** a separate credits add-on (starter allowance + consumable top-up packs + BYOK), **server-metered** via a Supabase Edge Function (paid credits can't be tracked client-side); not bundled into one-time Premium; stays deferred behind the dormant paywall infra. **Target: Q3 2026** — teased on the tester-facing Upcoming features screen 2026-07-07 (the "Subscription plans" teaser wording should move to "Premium" to match the one-time model); internal gating specifics stay internal-only.

## July 2026 Build Roadmap (provisional)

**Build order for the Horizon items, decided 2026-07-06. Build starts Jul 7.** Schedules **13 of the 15** Horizon items — **#4 (Password vault) and #6 (website/webapp) are deferred out of the July runway** (no demand signal / greenfield-and-large respectively); they stay on the Horizon list above, unscheduled.

**Sequencing rules:** (1) **#15 leads** — premium (one-time ₱249) gating infra must land before any feature it gates (#8 custom fonts). (2) **#15 is grilled to build-ready** ([subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md) §9–§10) and **#3 AI's monetization is resolved** (D8 — separate server-metered credits add-on + BYOK); the remaining #3 work is the *feature* build (Edge Function proxy, prompts, credits infra) — still a long pole, start it day 1. (3) Non-gated items fill the remaining weeks.

| Week | Dates | Items | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Jul 7–13 | **#15** premium gating infra (**grilled ✓** → build dormant, kill-switch OFF) · **#13** restart-fresh · **#14** display-currency symbol | #15 is the substantial work; #13/#14 are already-scoped no-grill fillers. **#15 grill done (one-time ₱249); kick off #3 AI grill day 1.** |
| 2 | Jul 14–20 | **#8** custom fonts (born gated, follows #15) · **#7** CSV/PDF export · **#10** change password/email · **#12** login rate-limit | Mostly small/medium |
| 3 | Jul 21–27 | **#11** delete account (RPC + couple-unpair) · **#1** Google Sign-In · **#2** Facebook Login (reuses #1's OAuth) · **#9** profile/couple photo · **#5** voice recording | **Overloaded (5 items)** — #5 or #9 is the first to bump to August if anything slips |
| 4 | Jul 28–31 | **#3** AI companion (dedicated build; grilled across W1–3) | Short week (4 days) — see honesty note |

**Honesty note:** this is aggressive — 13 items in ~3.5 weeks, solo, each slice on-device-tested before commit. Weeks 1–2 (small ready items + #15) are realistic; **Weeks 3–4 are the squeeze.** #3 AI is greenfield and the heaviest item — building it in a 4-day week is a plan on paper; realistically its build *starts* end of July and **finishes early August** even with its grill done ahead. Treat the July fit as the stretch target, not a commitment. All dates provisional — grilling will reshuffle order and scope. This roadmap supersedes the per-item "Target: Q3 2026" lines above for the 13 scheduled items.

21. `2026-07-24_couple_banner.sql` ([V1.7.0](v1.7.0.md) Item 10 — `couples.banner_url text` (nullable, metadata-only add) + `set_couple_banner(p_url)` RPC (member-gated, bumps `updated_at`→`server_rev` so the URL pulls back; either partner may set it, D1) + a private `couple-banners` Storage bucket with one `couple_banners_rw` RLS policy keyed on `auth_couple_id()` (SECURITY DEFINER → no base-table RLS trap, ADR-0043; both partners resolve the same couple, so either can read/write) + `unpair()` rebuilt to delete the couple's banner object under `{couple_id}/` before the couple row goes (decision 6; `delete_account()` inherits this via its own `unpair()` call, so no separate clause there). Applied + verified live via the Supabase MCP `apply_migration` 2026-07-24 — column/RPC/bucket(private)/policy/unpair-cleanup all confirmed present.)

22. `2026-07-26_notification_inbox.sql` ([V1.7.1](v1.7.1.md) Item 6, code `ccf933b`, ADR-0053 — the `notifications` table: the synced source of truth for every notification the app raises. `id` is **`text`, not uuid** — a deterministic composite key derived from the event itself (`budget:{budget_id}:{yyyy-MM}:{slot}`, `recurring:{occurrence}`, `debt:{debt_id}`), so the same event detected independently on phone and web merges into one row instead of duplicating; clients generate create-if-absent, never upsert-over, so re-detection can't overwrite read/dismissed state. Own-user-only: RLS is a single own-row `for all` policy (which also covers the retention sweep's DELETE), there is **no partner redacting view**, and the table is never replicated — Item 9's "partner logged a debt" notification lands as the *recipient's own* row, generated by their own client from the already-synced debt. Plus the standard `set_server_rev()` trigger and `server_rev`/`user_id` indexes. Retention: rows older than 60 days are **hard-deleted** by the client sweep — a narrow sanctioned exception to ADR-0010's tombstone-only rule, resurrection-safe because every client computes the same cutoff; user dismiss/clear-all remain ordinary syncing soft-deletes. Applied + verified live via the Supabase MCP 2026-07-26 — 11 columns, `id` text, rev trigger, 2 indexes, RLS + own-row policy all confirmed present.)
23. `2026-07-28_transaction_is_adjustment.sql` ([V1.7.1](v1.7.1.md) Item 13, ADR-0057 — `transactions.is_adjustment boolean not null default false`: manual balance-correction ledger rows, mirroring `is_settlement`'s shape. `partner_transactions` **dropped and recreated** (not `CREATE OR REPLACE` — Postgres rejects inserting a column mid-list via replace) to surface the column on the partner-read path. No RLS change; the exclusion from Analysis/Budgets/Combined spend totals is client-side calculator logic, not a view/policy concern. Applied + verified live via the Supabase MCP `apply_migration` 2026-07-28 — column + rebuilt view both confirmed carrying `is_adjustment`.)

### Paywall ↔ V1.6.5 sequencing (added 2026-07-07 — remove once paywall infra ships)

The two initiatives run **in parallel, not sequentially** — neither blocks the other from starting (full reasoning: [subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md) §6/§10.2).
- **Paywall dormant infra** (`core/billing`, `core/entitlement`, `FeatureAccess`/`PlanLimits`, paywall screen — kill-switch OFF) is fully grilled (D1–D8) and can start immediately; nothing in [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) blocks it.
- **v1.6.5.md's 18 items** are almost entirely independent of the infra and can be picked off in any order around it.
- **The only touchpoints:** Items 2/3/4 (records stepper, analysis ranges, notes char limit) need their *base behavior* built before their *tier-split gate* gets wired later — not before the infra starts. Item 12 (Premium Settings entry) is really part of the paywall build itself, not a separate slice.
- **Practical order:** finish grilling v1.6.5.md (in progress) → start the paywall infra build (the long pole — "day 1" per the July roadmap above) → thread the ready v1.6.5.md items in around it, in any order.

### supabase-kt 3.x API notes

- `upsert(rows: List<T>)` is a `suspend fun` returning `Unit` — no `.execute()` chaining.
- `select { filter { gt("col", cursor) }; order("col", Order.ASCENDING); limit(n.toLong()) }.decodeList<T>()` — `select {}` returns a builder; `decodeList<T>()` executes.
- `WorkManager.enqueueUniqueWork()` requires `OneTimeWorkRequest`, not `WorkRequest`.

### Per-feature pattern

Copy from any existing feature. `feature/x/` → `data/local` (Entity impl `SyncMeta` + DAO), `data/remote` (Dto `@Serializable` + RemoteSource port + `SupabaseXRemoteSource`), `data/XMapper.kt` (toDomain/toDto/toEntity), `XRepositoryImpl`, `data/sync/XTableSyncer`; `domain/model|repository|usecase`; `presentation/`. Then: add to `IponDatabase` + bump the Room version, add the DAO to `DatabaseModule`, add `XModule` (`@Binds`), add the route to `IponApp`.
